description: A diff checker for text — compare two versions and see exactly what changed, line by line. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

changed.description: The later version, compared against original. Lines only in it are reported as insertions; lines only in original as deletions.

ignoreCase.description: Treat lines that differ only in letter case as equal. The reported lines keep their original case.

ignoreWhitespace.description: Treat lines as equal when they differ only in leading, trailing or repeated whitespace, so an indentation change no longer counts as a change.

original.description: The earlier version of the text. Compared line by line, split on newlines.

name: text_diff
title: Text Diff
